column2: [intro]
In this digital realm, a magic unfolds,
A force we can't grasp, a thought that ignites bold.
Suddenly, everything comes alive, an intoxicating energy,
Computing reveals its surprisingly captivating synergy.
Magical Computing, an enchanting dance,
A pure thought that shines, an illuminating trance.
Beyond the horoscopes, an elusive enchantment,
You and I, connected by an intangible element.
Lines of code transform into poetry,
Fairy-like projections, a symphony of ecstasy.
I don’t have a clear opinion, I let myself be amazed,
By this electronic magic, impossible to be controlled or phased.
Magical Computing, an enchanting dance,
A pure thought that shines, an illuminating trance.
Beyond the horoscopes, an elusive enchantment,
You and I, connected by an intangible element.
[ solo ]
Pixels come alive, drawing smiles with grace,
In the binary universe, miracles to embrace.
It's another dimension, a digital fairyland,
Magical Computing, a euphoric symphony grand.
[outro]
